verdict.rationale: LibreChat has a first-party docs page titled "Subagents" (librechat-docs-31), which indicates a native multi-agent capability. However, the pack contains only that page title, with no description of how subagents are spawned, coordinated, or run in parallel. Selecting an agent via "@" mention is just agent selection, not orchestration, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented detail on subagent delegation and parallel execution, swarm or agent-to-agent protocol support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
